g.text: Airflow on CPU Docker / Manual run_id, no periodic schedule
Airflow validates and publishes metadata. A separate Helm deployment chooses
a sealed snapshot and copies it into each Retrieval MCP Pod at startup.
A1 retrieval calls search_knowledge on the deployed MCP server.
That query reads the existing index and does not run the K1 DAG.
